title: /config: the checks, the same-model toggle for Plan and Implement, and the Apps page
description:
Per the map tickets 'Prototype: the /config modal' (harness-0sx.9, CHECKS, PLAN + IMPLEMENT and APPS, as revised) and 'Apps per Stage' (harness-0sx.14); prototype as in Ticket 9.

Checks refuse a change; nothing is ever saved broken. The rules: plan and implementation one family (on a split); the Review and its fallback never on Implement's model (the same model across apps counts: opus = opus-5.5 = anthropic/claude-opus-5-5); the Debate's sides from two families, a family that cannot be told counting as a failure. Default models: claude's default counts as Anthropic, codex's as OpenAI, any other App's is family unknown, so the rows a check reads (Implement, the Review, its fallback, both Debate sides) need a named model there. A refused pick says 'Refused: <rule>. Nothing changed.'; the pick list marks each model that would break one ('✗ not Implement's family', '✗ the Review's model', '✗ Implement's model', '✗ side A's family', '? family unknown'). The left list marks a Stage ✗ or ?, the title badge counts them, and CHECKS on the Review and Debate pages spell each rule out ('Plans on fable and implements on opus, both Anthropic.'). A config.json edited by hand that breaks a rule shows ✗ and refuses a run, naming the rule.

Plan + Implement: '[x] Same model for plan and implementation', Enter or Space toggles. On (the default) one model plans and implements. Turning it off opens the plan's model list, models of Implement's family on Implement's app; picking one splits (Ticket 8's plan model) and 'plan model' and 'implement model' rows appear; picking Implement's own model turns it back on; Esc keeps one model. Off is refused when the app cannot split (only claude can) and when Implement's model is default ('Pick Implement's model first: the split needs a named model for each half.'). A new app for Plan + Implement plans on the same model again, so an app change never strands the plan.

Apps page: the App table's rows, each installed or not (on PATH; herdr's integration.list reports {command, available} per app), with its version; the other herdr-integrated apps greyed 'not supported yet'. Not installed: greyed 'not installed' here and in every app list; picking one opens a window '<app> is not installed' with its homepage and 'install it, then run harness init again'; Enter opens the homepage (open or xdg-open through Tools), Esc closes.

The reasoning behind each decision is on the map's closed tickets: bd show harness-0sx.<n> --json --include-comments. Research notes and prototypes live on local branches: git show research/<name>:docs/research/<file>.md, git show prototype/<name>:<path>. Vocabulary: CONTEXT.md. Decisions: docs/adr/. Rust; crates limited to serde, serde_json, regex, chrono, crossterm, ratatui and ureq, anything else needs a ticket.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests of the rules over row tables, cross-app model identity and unknown families included. Screen tests: a refused pick leaves config.json byte for byte as it was and says the rule; the toggle off with Implement at default is refused; a split, then an app change, is one model again; a hand-edited config.json that breaks a rule refuses the run; the not-installed window opens the homepage through fake Tools. TestBackend renders of the marks and the Apps page.
